verdict.rationale: Devin's architecture is inherently session-based, and docs show API/CLI support for creating and managing sessions programmatically, including creating sessions on behalf of other users (create_as_user_id) and MCP-based session management/scheduling—useful for a lead overseeing multiple agents. However, there's no explicit documentation of a unified dashboard view for tracking/comparing multiple concurrent sessions across a team in one screen. Missing for 10: dedicated multi-session dashboard UI evidence, team-wide session oversight features, and independent confirmation of managing multiple sessions at scale.
